name: ATTENTION DEFICIT: A story about ADHD
source:
A visual novel following Clara, a girl with ADHD, as she races against a seven-day deadline to finish a school project. Your choices shape how she copes with life’s challenges and whether she succeeds.

[From [url=https://syphyous.itch.io/adhd]Itch.io[/url]]
